source_grounded_key_points: 1 GEOMETRIC TWINS 1.1 Geometric Twins The symbol on this signboard needs to be recreated on another board.
One way is to trace the outline of this symbol on tracing paper to reconstruct the figure.
Can we take some measurements that would allow us to exactly recreate this figure?
A C B Are the arm lengths AB and BC sufficient to exactly recreate this figure?
We observe that several such symbols can be constructed with the same lengths.
C C C A A A A C B B B B To get the exact replica, would it help to take any other measurement?
The measure of ∠ABC, along with the two arm lengths AB and BC, fix the shape and size of this figure.
Can you draw the symbol if it is known that AB = 4 cm, BC = 8 cm, and ∠ABC = 80°?
These three measurements can help us create an exact replica of the symbol on the signboard.
Figures that are exact copies of each other or have the same shape and size are said to be congruent.
